messages:
Noah (sales): WillowBank procurement emailed: they need SOC2 Type II, ISO scope statement (if we have one), a named pen-test attestation, and confirmation POC data will remain in eu-west-1. They want it before Thursday AM.
Ellen (solutions): We can provide SOC2 and ISO scope statement (we have a scope doc, not a cert). Region pinning to eu-west-1 for 30 days is doable but needs ops ticket.
Priya (security): I'll pull SOC2 PDF + controls matrix today. For pen-test attestation: vendor summary available, but vendor raw report cannot be shared per contract. Legal-signed attestation requires vendor summary first.
Victor (legal): I can sign an attestation letter addressed to WillowBank (Attn: S. Ortega) once security provides the vendor summary. Keep wording factual and limited.
Noah (sales): Recipient: procure@willowbank.eu, Attn: Sofia Ortega. Ask if they accept a vendor summary + signed attestation rather than full report.
Ellen (solutions): Checklist Ill track: SOC2 PDF (Priya), controls matrix (Priya), vendor summary (Priya), attestation draft (Victor), ops region ticket (ops-bot).
ops-bot: Created ops ticket OP-8029 for region pin; estimated completion 18h.
Priya (security): SOC2 + controls matrix uploaded to secure drive. Link: https://drive.redwood.com/willow-poc (expires 7d). Vendor summary ready by Wed 15:00 CET.
Victor (legal): Drafted attestation tonight. Sample line: "This attestation is provided solely for the benefit of WillowBank in connection with its evaluation of Redwood Inference." No warranties.
Noah (sales): I'll message procurement with ETA: "Target delivery Wed afternoon. Please confirm if that meets your review schedule." :thumbsup:
Ellen (solutions): Also note: if Willow requests additional custom SOW items (eg. extended region residency beyond POC), we'll quote separately.
Noah (sales): Thanks team. I'll log the share link in CRM and close once signed letter and vendor summary are included.
